name: Skytiger Guards HQ
desc: The Skytigers are a combination of capitol guard and long-service mercenary force; indeed, the patronage-centric nature of Magellan elite society deliberately blurs the lines between public duties to the state and private duties to their sponsors, and nowhere is this more evident than in the astonishing brutality of their responses to uprisings and insurrections among Jeshad’s lower classes. Skytiger officers are born among Annore’s elite, or raised to the peerage as an easy method of ensuring their loyalty, and they have attitudes to match; most care little more for the common spacers of their fleets than for the starvelings they gun down for their masters. This massively fortified building serves as a center for the recruitment, training, and command of the elite guard divisions that patrol Annore's local space.

name: Magellan Fleet HQ
desc: Headquarters of the Magellan Protectorate Fleet, this facility coordinates all military fleet movements within the Protectorate sphere of influence. Numerous patrols of the elite Blackcollar Regiment supplement the harried forces of the regular navy in maintaining peace and order within the Khamn system and beyond. Generations of resource scarcity compounded by the Skytiger Guards skimming what little remained has taught the regular armed forces to make do with less. Thus, despite the vast bureaucratic machinery present within these walls, the Magellan Fleet is administered with remarkable frugality.

name: Tichel Distribution Hub
desc: Headquarters of the Tichel Mercantile Concern, the largest and most powerful merchant guild of the Magellan Protectorate. Tichel has grow unimaginably rich off their monopolist royal charter for all procurement and distribution of volatiles within Magellan space. Much of Pariya is their fiefdom in all but name, and their private security forces, the Yellowtails, are a law unto themselves.
